note: GEO six-apps set (added 2026-11-23, per anicca-ops team-outbox/muse/to-seo-geo-loops-2026-11-23-six-apps-entity-pages.md): per-app prompt sets for the 5 non-flagship apps, 16 prompts each = 80 total. Each app: 8 EN + 8 JP, mixing ask-form (the app's suffering/intent) and app-form (category recommendation). Denominators are recorded PER APP and must never be merged into the Anicca 148 denominator. App facts are taken only from the live /dais product list (read back 2026-11-23) and the six-apps audit: Honne (App Store ID 6759667221, Utilities) — paste a conversation to explore AI-generated interpretations and possible replies, suggestions not facts; Dhamma Quotes / Daily Dhamma (6757726663, Health & Fitness) — Dhammapada verses, bookmarks, mindfulness reminders; Sleep Reset (6762143790, Health & Fitness) — free sleep reset score and recovery outlook, personalized plans / bedtime timing / guided breathwork require a paid subscription; Thankful (6759514159, Health & Fitness) — write three gratitude entries, daily affirmations, journaling streak; STUDIO CHERIE (6766485903, Lifestyle) — register clothes, shoes and accessories by photo, plan outfits from your own wardrobe, save combinations, Resting Box organization. Brand match targets per app are the app name plus aniccaai.com product path (/honne, /dailydharma, /sleepreset, /thankful, /studio-cherie).
